name: Eternal Separation
overview: Scripture reveals that eternal separation from God is the ultimate consequence for those who reject Christ, as Jesus declares the cursed will be sent into everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels (Matthew 25:41). This separation is the result of judgment following death (Hebrews 9:27) and is depicted vividly at the great white throne judgment (Revelation 20:11). However, God’s love offers salvation and eternal life to all who believe in His Son, Jesus, who is the only way to the Father (John 3:16; John 14:6). Thus, eternal separation underscores the critical necessity of faith in Christ for reconciliation with God.
